Prepared reusable program derived from independently executed first-pass 164-check logic. No historical case IDs/results are reused.

limitations: Pre-gate effect0 and API replay revision stability have no standalone saved before-journal/replay response in these files; exact terminal testcase attestation is separate.

Browser request listener does not record page.request API calls, including intentional physical-authorization replay; one browser POST is not a claim of only one HTTP request. Durable receipt/effect1 plus exact test assertion establish replay idempotence when JUnit passes.
No full DOM/caption/dropdown or trace secret audit performed; manual exact-source loop remains pending.
Saved DB hashes are capture-time metadata only; no DB opened or rehashed.
Real protocol lab fault cases use synthetic runtime; only happy has actual Blender evaluated-scene motion proof.
Whole campaign and remote gates are not passed by a single-suite case review.
